project.name: OPM_Toolset
project.description: An Fiji plugin to process OPM data: 1.0.0: initial mavenized ImageJ project 1.1.0: function separation, added folder watcher 1.2.0: implementing folder watcher, with Memory Monitor reference 1.3.2: try start/stop enabled watcher with Runnable 1.3.3: enrich parameter dialog 1.4.0: configured folder watcher 1.5.0: use WatchService api 1.5.1: added button control of WatchService start/stop 1.5.2: updated GUI 1.5.3: enriched parameter class and functions 1.5.4: fixed minor bugs in parameter persistence 1.6.0: cleaned code, make use of GPU processing whenever possible 1.6.1: fixed various bugs of class: Parameter, Projection, and Geometry 1.6.2: fixed bug that ImageJ reslice result image with static title "Resclie of " + imp.getTitle(), but not imp.getShortTitle() 1.6.3: enriched code to account for hyperstack cases on GPU 1.6.4: partition hyperstack to Map<czt_label, ImagePlus(2d or 3d)> 1.6.5: fixed bug in x,y,z projection of hyperstack 1.6.6: fixed projection in deskew image option 1.6.7: improved deskew active image dialog and processing workflow 1.7.0: enriched batch processing workflow 1.8.0: arranged function to GPU, CPU, Partition classes 1.8.1: add function to combine time lapse 1.8.2: add function to partition data for GPU processing 1.8.3: add functions to make PSF from beads stack, for deconvolution 1.8.4: add Tranform command and parameter GUI 1.8.5: enabled partition for affine transform 1.8.6: cleaned up code for volume transform 1.8.7: update deskew live image dialog and functionalities 1.8.8: unify deskew live and deskew image 1.8.9: cleaned up code for deskew 1.9.0: add physical calibration 2.0.0: add deconvolution function, from local jar pacakge 2.0.1 - 2.1.4: released before this repository was created; no per-version record survives 2.1.5: imported as the project baseline (git tag v2.1.5) 2.1.6: CPU parity, headless correctness, and a corrected deskew output grid 2.1.6: one raw-volume loader in VolumeIO, with the Bio-Formats Z/T axis fix applied once 2.1.6: store deskewed volumes as Deflate TIFF, one strip per plane, read back in parallel 2.1.6: canonical acquisition-level OME-Zarr output with an opm-provenance record, resumable 2.1.6: Fiji-native OME-Zarr viewer, virtual or materialised, plus a live-update prototype 2.1.6: multi-channel acquisition layout for Deskew Batch and Live Processing 2.1.6: harden the live listener: recursion, retry, resume, and loud failures 2.1.6: rewrite Live Deskew around metadata first: volumes are held until the geometry is known 2.1.6: simple/advanced Live setup dialog, per-run log file, per-stage timing, live preview 2.1.6: output format as one choice of TIFF, OME-Zarr or both, so a Zarr run writes no TIFF tree 2.1.6: measured disk-space forecasting per volume, warning under 4 h and critical under 1 h 2.1.6: cooperative cancellation, so a batch run stops with Escape and never outlives Fiji 2.1.6: Format conversion command: raw BigTIFF to Deflate TIFF or OME-Zarr, without deskewing 2.1.6: read and export a bounded X/Y/Z region of a dataset without opening the whole volume 2.1.6: parameter persistence driven by the @Persist annotation instead of two hand-written lists 2.1.6: audit repairs: blank batch keyword, multi-channel CPU projections, per-command Parameter 2.1.6: audit repairs: format-aware resume, folder-local geometry, output excluded from discovery
